subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should global auth switching refresh only sessions that inherit provider auth, or may it also clear explicit per-session auth/profile pins and interrupt active runs?
rationale: Source evidence establishes the missing capability, but repository behavior does not define the permanent ownership, authorization, explicit-pin precedence, or active-run semantics required for safe implementation.

options.title: Refresh inherited auth only
options.body: Add an admin-scoped refresh that invalidates runtime auth bindings for inherited routing while preserving explicit session pins and deferring active sessions to a safe boundary.

options.title: Force all sessions to current auth
options.body: Clear inherited and explicit auth overrides across all agents and define interruption or retry behavior for active runs, accepting a larger compatibility and security surface.

options.title: Keep per-session operations
options.body: Decline a global mutation API and improve diagnostics or tooling that enumerates affected sessions for explicit operator action.

recommendation.title: Refresh inherited auth only
recommendation.body: Add an admin-scoped refresh that invalidates runtime auth bindings for inherited routing while preserving explicit session pins and deferring active sessions to a safe boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal covers the Gateway session-reset service, method surface, and the prior decision to retain this canonical tracker.
